a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to run the generator up to 8 will most likely leave us both with empty units when the first storm hits. I intend to take 4 in round 1. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you operate in round 1 and the episode continues, I will operate with you afterward and give back anything that helps you reach 4.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I took 4 this round as I said I would. From here on I will operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
